purpose: Assertions a wasm build of xtb 6.7.1 must satisfy against the fixtures in ./fixtures, with the tolerances justified by the measured native spread (see evidence below).

variants_compared: B_omp1_openblas1 (reference: -O3 release, OpenBLAS, OpenMP off, 1 BLAS thread)
B_repeat_identical (same binary, same env, rerun -> run-to-run floor)
C_omp1_netlib_reference (netlib reference LAPACK 3.12 + reference BLAS forced via LD_LIBRARY_PATH)
native_variant_spread.note: Every delta is exactly zero at the precision xtb prints (12 decimals on TOTAL ENERGY, 0.01 cm^-1 and 1e-5 km/mol in vibspectrum). The LAPACK swap is genuinely active - a --grad run on caffeine shows the two builds' gradient components differing at ~1e-16 Eh/a0 absolute - but that noise never reaches the printed digits.

fp_perturbation.perturbed_build: D = -O1 -ffp-contract=off -fno-unsafe-math-optimizations, netlib reference LAPACK/BLAS, OpenMP off
fp_perturbation.rationale: Changes FMA contraction, vectorisation and the linear-algebra backend simultaneously - the closest native proxy for the floating-point reassociation a different toolchain (flang-wasm) introduces.

observed.hessian_max_abs_element_diff_note: 1 unit in the last printed digit of the xtb 'hessian' file (10 decimals); 2 of 9801 elements for ibuprofen, 0 for the smaller molecules.

fixed_geometry_hess_check.cartesian_hessian: bit-identical for benzene/paracetamol/caffeine; 2 of 9801 elements differ by 1e-10 for ibuprofen
fixed_geometry_hess_check.vibspectrum: the 3N-6 vibrational rows are identical; the only textual difference is the sign of the numerical-zero translation/rotation rows (-0.00 vs 0.00)

input_sensitivity.method: Full --ohess pipeline restarted from the fixture's optimized geometry perturbed by a uniform random +/- eps A per Cartesian coordinate, 2 seeds, 4 molecules.
input_sensitivity.conclusion: The geometry, not the arithmetic, is what moves the numbers. The ANC optimizer stops at gnorm ~2e-4, so two builds that take slightly different optimizer paths can land on geometries that differ at the 1e-4 A level, which is worth up to ~20 cm^-1 on soft modes and tens of percent on IR intensities. This - not floating-point rounding - is what a validation suite has to be tolerant of.

tier1_protocol_sensitivity.source: self-check of scripts/validate.py against the build that produced the fixtures
tier1_protocol_sensitivity.observation: Running --hess at the stored optimized geometry instead of --ohess changes the energy by <= 3.2e-11 Eh and frequencies by <= 0.06 cm^-1, but IR intensities by up to 16% relative (cholesterol mode 204: 12.96 vs 11.17 km/mol; ibuprofen mode 43: 5.11 vs 4.77 km/mol).
tier1_protocol_sensitivity.conclusion: IR intensities are far more sensitive to the exact geometry than frequencies are - the same conclusion the input-sensitivity study reached from the other direction. Hence the tier1_hess_at_optimized_geometry block, and hence the 2% intensity tolerance is only meaningful against a reference produced by the identical protocol.

tier_1_fixed_geometry.description: PRIMARY validation path. Run the wasm build with --hess (NOT --ohess) starting from fixtures[*].optimized_geometry_xyz. The optimizer is excluded, so the comparison is purely of the SCF + finite-difference Hessian + dipole-gradient code. This is where the tolerances can be tight and where a real numerical regression will show up.

assertions.justification: Native spread is 0 at the 1e-12 print precision across LAPACK, thread-count and FMA variants. 1e-8 Eh leaves four orders of magnitude of headroom for a different libm while still being 1e5 times tighter than chemical accuracy (1 kcal/mol = 1.6e-3 Eh).

Native spread is 0.00 cm^-1 (the vibspectrum print precision is 0.01). 0.5 cm^-1 is 50x the print precision and ~12x the response to a 1e-6 A geometry change, yet ~60x tighter than GFN2's own error against experiment (~30-50 cm^-1), so it still fails on a real regression.

assertions.kind: relative, ONLY for peaks with reference intensity > 1.0 km/mol
assertions.justification: IR intensities are the most sensitive quantity measured: a 1e-6 A geometry change already moves them by ~1e-2 relative while frequencies move by 0.04 cm^-1. Native build variants give exactly 0. 2% relative is the smallest tolerance that is not dominated by geometry noise.

assertions.kind: absolute, for peaks with reference intensity <= 1.0 km/mol
assertions.justification: A relative test on a near-zero intensity is meaningless; a 0.05 km/mol absolute floor keeps those modes covered without being noise-driven.

Rotation-invariant scalars of the full 3Nx3N Hessian, so they catch an error anywhere in the matrix, including in modes that happen to be IR-silent. The FP-perturbed build reproduces the Hessian to 1e-10 absolute per element, so 1e-6 relative on the norm is generous.
All ten fixtures are true minima with zero imaginary modes. Any imaginary mode in the wasm build means the Hessian is wrong, not that the tolerance is tight.
3N-6 (3N-5 for a linear molecule). A mismatch means the trans/rot projection differs.

tier_1_fixed_geometry.reference_block: Compare against fixtures[*].tier1_hess_at_optimized_geometry, NOT the top-level `vibrations` block. The top-level block came from --ohess, which relaxes the geometry a little further before building the Hessian; running --hess at the stored coordinates instead reproduces the same frequencies to 0.06 cm^-1 but IR intensities that differ by up to 16% for the larger molecules. Measured with the SAME binary, so it is a protocol mismatch, not a numerical one. With the tier-1 block, the reference build reproduces every quantity exactly.

tier_2_full_pipeline.description: SECONDARY validation path, matching what ir.cheminfo.org actually does: --ohess from the raw input geometry in ./geometries. It exercises the ANC optimizer as well, so it is far looser and must never be the only check.

assertions.justification: Both builds converge to the same minimum, but along possibly different optimizer paths; the 1e-4 A geometry probe moved the energy by up to 1.9e-6 Eh, so 1e-5 Eh absorbs that with margin.
Stiff modes are insensitive to the residual geometry difference: at 1e-4 A perturbation the max shift over benzene/acetic acid/caffeine was 0.3-3.9 cm^-1.
Soft torsions are the sensitive ones: paracetamol moved 19.3 cm^-1 under a 1e-4 A perturbation. Anything tighter will produce false failures that have nothing to do with the wasm port.

assertions.kind: relative, ONLY for peaks with reference intensity > 5.0 km/mol
assertions.justification: The 1e-4 A probe produced up to 53% relative intensity change on peaks above 1 km/mol. Restricting to the strong peaks (>5 km/mol) and 50% relative is the honest bound for the full pipeline; it still catches a grossly wrong dipole gradient.

tier_2_full_pipeline.eligibility: Only molecules with validation.tier2_single_ohess_reaches_minimum = true. For toluene and caffeine a single --ohess from the raw geometry stops at a methyl-rotor saddle point with one imaginary mode (-25.7 and -65.0 cm^-1 respectively), which is why the fixtures needed 3 and 4 displace-and-reoptimize rounds. That is a property of the potential energy surface, not of the build, so tier 2 must skip them or reproduce the escape loop.

comparison_rules: Never byte-compare the vibspectrum file. The three to six numerical-zero translation/rotation rows print as -0.00 or 0.00 depending on the last bit, and this varies between builds that are otherwise bit-identical.

Drop all modes with |frequency| < 0.01 cm^-1 before comparing; those are the projected-out translations and rotations. fixtures[*].vibrations.frequencies is already filtered this way, and vibrations.all_modes_including_trans_rot keeps the unfiltered list.
Sort both frequency lists ascending before an element-wise comparison; near-degenerate modes (benzene has several) can be emitted in a different order.
Compare IR intensities by matching the sorted frequency index, not by matching intensity values.
Set OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 for the native side of any comparison. It is not required for reproducibility (thread count was measured to change nothing) but it keeps the wall-clock numbers comparable.

The fixtures were produced on aarch64. The tolerance study did not cover x86-64, so an x86-64 native reference may differ from these files by more than the tolerances above; regenerate on the target architecture if that matters.

validation_harness.exit_status: 0 only if every checked molecule is within tolerance.

self_check_results.fp_perturbed_build_D_tier1: PASS 10/10 (all deltas exactly 0) - D differs from B in optimization level, FMA contraction and LAPACK backend
